provenance.method: Conservative whole-second scheduling estimates from October 5 Node 22/26 scenario timings and October 2 audit. Original sweep uses the prior 248.6s observation (October 5 max 229s); remote re-create reserves 100s (observed 85s / prior 90s). Command-matrix estimates reserve 20s for path and 60s for arity after the paired builder measured 13.55s combined versus 79.76s before on the same host; these are conservative CI estimates, not measured post-change CI durations. Unknown files receive a positive 10-second estimate. Weights schedule work only and never select coverage. Refresh from exact-SHA CI when costs change.
